implementation.transport: two-pass four-lane saturated fractional EMAC helper with direct CPU-state and guest-memory access
implementation.fallback: Execute the native translated boundary unless the control, loop-count, saturated fractional EMAC mode, and full-mask guards all pass.

same_process_oracle.workload: generated slot-1 sample with held Trig 1 and all fifteen prior TCG helpers enabled

profiling_note: The bounded handoff leaf is deterministic across runs. Full ISR totals can vary with the generated sample phase, so the incremental acceptance metric is the exact 0x40108C7C..0x4010A06A window rather than a subtraction between unpaired whole-ISR runs.
conclusion: The sixteenth guarded direct-state helper matches the native two-pass four-lane EMAC boundary at early and late cursor positions and removes exactly 2,700 executed guest instructions per 100 services from the deterministic handoff leaf.
next_gate: Run a fresh exact per-PC profile of the remaining 18,100-instruction handoff leaf and select the next independently replayable deterministic boundary.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: Only clean-room bounded arithmetic and aggregate results are committed. No Elektron firmware, project data, sample names, PCM, runtime values, runtime trace, or instruction bytes are committed.
